visible_entities: Blonde curly-haired woman wearing a white shirt with small red hearts
Dark curly-haired bearded man wearing glasses and a blue hoodie
observable_actions: The woman holds up a peeled banana while the man stands beside her and touches her shoulder briefly
The man gives a thumbs-up while the woman raises and presents the banana toward him
The woman holds the banana in front of the man; he leans forward and bites the exposed banana around 4.2 seconds
After the bite, the man looks down at the banana with widened eyes and a changed facial expression
review.before_state: The woman is holding a mostly intact peeled banana; both characters appear relaxed and smiling.
review.after_state: The banana has a visible bite taken from its tip; the man is looking down at it with a more uncertain/surprised expression while the woman remains pleased.
review.cause_and_reaction: The visible sequence places the man's bite immediately before his changed facial expression; the exact reason for the reaction is not visually established.
review.story_function: Setup and first payoff: establish the banana, show the woman offering it, then preserve the man's bite and immediate reaction.
must_preserve: The banana remains the central prop
The man's thumbs-up before accepting the banana
The woman presenting the banana directly to him
The bite around 4.0–4.3 seconds and the immediate reaction
Keep the woman's pleased expression contrasted with the man's changed expression
uncertain_or_unobservable: The man's internal reason for the reaction cannot be determined from still frames alone
Exact bite onset and end must be confirmed by source playback
review.reviewer_notes: Evidence samples 0, 1, 4, 7, 13, 17, 19 and 21. Sample 17 at 4.233s shows the bite in progress; sample 19 at 4.733s shows the changed expression.

visible_entities: Blonde curly-haired woman in a white heart-print shirt
Man with glasses and a blue hoodie
Bitten banana resting on the countertop
observable_actions: The woman lowers the bitten banana onto the countertop around 7.7–8.0 seconds
The woman raises and waves/extends one hand while the man watches her and then makes a similar forward arm gesture
Both characters hold their arms extended toward the foreground for several beats
Around 11.7 seconds, the woman's arm crosses the man's face and his head/upper body recoils sharply
At the final sample, the woman is moving out of frame to the left while the bitten banana remains on the counter
review.before_state: The woman is still holding the bitten banana; the man remains focused on her and the banana.
review.after_state: The bitten banana is left on the counter; the man has recoiled and the woman moves leftward out of the frame.
review.cause_and_reaction: The sampled images show an arm crossing the man's face followed by a strong recoil. They do not conclusively establish whether this is a deliberate slap, playful contact, or a motion/animation artifact.
review.story_function: Closing gesture and physical-comedy beat; preserve the banana as a persistent prop and the final recoil/exit rather than ending on the earlier close-up.
must_preserve: The woman places the bitten banana on the counter and it stays there through the ending
The characters' reciprocal arm gestures before the final recoil
The arm crossing the man's face and his immediate recoil as a visual beat, subject to playback verification
The final image of the woman leaving frame while the banana remains on the counter
uncertain_or_unobservable: Do not label the contact definitively as a slap until the original video is played at normal speed and frame-by-frame
The purpose of the reciprocal arm gestures is unclear from stills
No dialogue or spoken explanation is evidenced by the contact sheet
review.reviewer_notes: Evidence samples 30–48 (7.5–12.0s). Sample 47 at 11.733s shows the strongest apparent contact/recoil; sample 48 at 12.0s shows the woman moving left and the banana remaining on the counter.
